name: Extended Link
effect: When distance or ordinary structure would worsen signal, treat it as one step better. Does not bypass hard Lost zones.

name: Relay Node
effect: Acts as a local repeater. One allied drone or short comm signal routed through it treats signal as one step better while the relay survives.

name: Basic Autonomy Chip
effect: When signal is Lost, execute one loaded protocol: Freeze, Return, Follow Beacon, Record, Deliver, or Trigger Module. Cannot improvise.

name: Shielded Receiver
effect: Gain Advantage on checks to resist spoofing, light jamming, or ordinary interference. Does not resist hard Lost zones.

name: Neural Network Control
effect: Allows registered crew members to take control of the drone by turns while signal is Stable. It moves spotlight, not action economy.

name: Flight Module
effect: The drone can hover, cross gaps, move vertically, and fly at low speed in normal atmosphere. Strong wind, storms, damage, or tight terrain may require a roll. While flying, the drone takes -2 to Agility Rolls to avoid detection.

name: Wall-Crawler
effect: Climb walls, ceilings, ducts, and uneven surfaces unless slick, electrified, shielded, or hostile.

name: Cargo Grip
effect: Carry small objects, drag light loads, or retrieve items. Cannot carry a conscious adult unless the frame is built for hauling.

name: Low-Light Camera
effect: Ignore penalties from darkness short of total blackout, smoke, or sensor-obscuring interference.

name: Thermal Camera
effect: Detect heat signatures through darkness, smoke, or light cover. Insulation, decoys, cold-blooded species, and thermal masking can defeat it.

name: Radiation/Chem Sensor
effect: Detect radiation, toxins, corrosives, atmospheric hazards, or chemical traces. Grants Advantage on checks to identify environmental danger.

name: Audio Suite
effect: Directional listening and clean recording. Grants Advantage when eavesdropping through ordinary barriers.

name: Medical Scanner
effect: Reads vitals and triage data. Grants Advantage to assess injury or stabilize remotely, but does not replace a Medic.

name: Manipulator Arm
effect: Move small objects, plug cables, press controls, retrieve samples, or perform simple manual tasks.

name: Tool Mount
effect: Mount one small legal tool: welder, injector, scanner, lock probe, solder kit, sample drill.

name: Cutter
effect: Cut light doors, panels, cables, locks, and thin plating. Hardened targets require time or a successful roll.

name: Repair Kit
effect: With operator Action, grants Advantage on a repair roll or lets the drone perform minor repairs at range.

name: Medgel Injector
effect: Stabilize a wounded target at range with operator Action. Does not heal HP unless another rule allows it.

name: Noise Dampener
effect: The drone’s movement is silent to ordinary hearing. Does not hide heat, signal, light, airflow, or physical traces.

name: Stealth Shell
effect: Gain +1 on Agility Rolls to avoid detection while grounded or moving no more than one band and using no loud module. Attacking, cutting, boosting, a strong transmission, or moving more than one band ends the bonus until the drone spends a Spotlight meeting those requirements again. The flight penalty still applies.

name: Agile Servos
effect: +1 Evasion.

name: Low-Profile Frame
effect: +1 Evasion against ranged attacks while the drone is not carrying a heavy tool, weapon mount, cargo load, or armor plating.

name: Decoy Flare Pod
effect: One use per reload. Against ranged, missile, sensor-guided, or drone attacks, impose Disadvantage or gain +2 Evasion against that attack.

name: Smoke/Flash Pod
effect: One use per reload. Create a brief escape, distraction, breach window, or Advantage on one repositioning or infiltration action.

name: Compliance Taser
effect: Operator Action. Close attack. On hit, mark 1 Stress and force the target to drop an object, lose footing, or suffer momentary stun if fiction allows. Non-lethal and obvious.

name: Stun Dart
effect: Operator Action. Close/Far attack. On hit, deal 1d6 non-lethal physical damage or mark 1 Stress. Limited ammo. Legal status varies by port.

name: Military Flight Module
effect: The drone gains controlled tactical flight. While airborne, the operator gains +1 on rolls to maneuver, evade, chase, reposition, or pilot the drone. This bonus does not apply to attacks, hacking, repairs, scanning, or other non-movement tasks. While flying, the drone takes -2 to Agility Rolls to avoid detection.

name: Military Stealth Shell
effect: Gain +2 on Agility Rolls to avoid detection while grounded or moving no more than one band and using no loud module. Attacking, cutting, boosting, a strong transmission, or moving more than one band ends the bonus until the drone spends a Spotlight meeting those requirements again. The flight penalty still applies.

name: Armor Plating
effect: Gain +1 Armor Slot. The drone loses 1 Evasion while flying, sneaking, evading, or moving through tight terrain.

name: Target Painter
effect: Operator Action. Mark one visible personal-scale target until the start of the operator's next Spotlight. The next allied attack against it gains Advantage, then the mark ends. This is not a starship Sensor Lock.

name: Micro-Laser
effect: Operator Action. Far attack. Deal 1d6 energy. Precise, but easy to trace by heat or beam origin. Does not scale with Proficiency unless explicitly upgraded.

name: Hardened Link
effect: Treat Unstable as Stable for complex commands. Does not bypass Lost zones.

name: Fiber Spool
effect: Physical cable link. Ignores jamming while cable remains intact, but limits movement and can be cut.

name: Burst Transmitter
effect: Once per scene, resolve one command through Unstable signal without Disadvantage. If that Roll is Fear-dominant and noncritical, every established hostile sensor in the scene detects the drone's current zone until it moves.

name: Encrypted Control Suite
effect: Advantage against hijack and command injection.

name: Spoof Filter
effect: Once per scene, ask the Keeper if the drone’s feed is false, stale, looped, or manipulated.

name: Dedicated Relay Mast
effect: While stationary, improves signal for all allied drones in the scene by one step. Obvious to sensors.

name: Swarm Controller
effect: Allows one operator to command a swarm as one unit. Requires the operator’s whole Action.

name: Tactical Neural Mesh
effect: Hardened shared-control suite. The first control handoff each round while signal is Unstable does not require Stress or Disadvantage.

name: Tuned Servos
effect: Once per scene, Advantage on drone movement through tight, hostile, or collapsing terrain.

name: Silent Treads
effect: Movement makes no ordinary sound and stacks with Stealth Shell; while active, movement and chase Rolls have Disadvantage.

name: Grapple Line
effect: Cross vertical gaps, anchor to surfaces, pull light objects, or create a temporary line for small gear.

name: Mag-Clamps
effect: Attach to hulls, vehicles, metal walls, or moving machinery. Hard to remove without tools.

name: Micro-Thrusters
effect: Maneuver in EVA or low gravity. Once per scene, gain Advantage on a movement roll in zero-g or low gravity. Does not grant normal atmospheric flight unless paired with a Flight Module or Military Flight Module.

name: EVA Kit
effect: Full vacuum operation, radiation hardening, and micro-debris protection for short missions.

name: Submersible Kit
effect: Underwater or liquid operation. Signal usually starts Unstable unless tethered.

name: Crash Frame
effect: First environmental collision or fall in a scene does not damage the drone.

name: High-Speed Rotor Array
effect: +1 Evasion during chases or open movement and Advantage on Agility or Finesse Rolls made to move or chase. Agility Rolls to avoid detection have Disadvantage while active.

name: Signal Ghost
effect: Scans to detect drone take Disadvantage while passive. Loud action breaks concealment.

name: Thermal Ghost
effect: Thermal detection against the drone has Disadvantage. After a Fear-dominant noncritical Roll using the module, it goes offline until the end of the operator's next Spotlight.

name: False Transponder
effect: Identifies as maintenance/security unit from chosen faction or site. Requires plausible context.

name: Chameleon Skin
effect: Gain Advantage on Agility Rolls to avoid visual detection while stationary. Moving, losing HP, or exposure to rain or dust ends the benefit until the drone spends a Spotlight stationary and cleaning or recalibrating the skin.

name: Mimic Profile
effect: Copies sound/motion profile of local drones. Works until authorization is checked.

name: Dead Drop Cache
effect: Hidden compartment for 1 Burden or small contraband. Standard scans take Disadvantage unless searching.

name: Micromote Dispenser
effect: Releases tiny passive bugs/sensors. They only record or transmit short-range.

name: Multi-Spectrum Suite
effect: Low-light, thermal, radiation, and EM sensing. Advantage to detect hidden tech, heat, or hazards.

name: Forensic Sampler
effect: Collects biological, chemical, and particulate samples without contamination.

name: Motion Mapper
effect: Maps movement through walls or cover if material is not shielded. With Fear, may show ghost movement or false positives.

name: Signal Sniffer
effect: Detects active comms, relays, drones, trackers, and signal leaks. Does not decrypt.

name: Micro-LIDAR
effect: Creates precise 3D maps. Dust, fog, reflective surfaces, or countermeasures can distort it.

name: Veil Static Reader
effect: Detects established Veil interference or Power use from the current scene. On a Fear-dominant noncritical Roll using it, return no reading and the operator marks 1 Stress.

name: Emotional Pattern Scanner
effect: Experimental biometrics for stress, panic, aggression, or shock. Does not read thoughts.

name: Blackbox Recorder
effect: If destroyed, last few seconds of feed survive unless wiped or destroyed by appropriate damage.

name: Heavy Manipulator
effect: Lift, drag, or hold heavy objects. Can extract a wounded ally slowly if unopposed.

name: Precision Tool Arm
effect: Advantage on delicate repair, lock, surgery-assist, or disarmament tasks remotely.

name: Breach Kit
effect: Open standard doors, panels, locks, hatches. Military security requires roll and time.

name: Hull Patch Kit
effect: Seal minor breaches, leaks, pressure failures. Not enough for catastrophic hull damage.

name: Sample Vault
effect: Stores one hazardous sample. When a hit causes the drone HP loss, its operator may choose this module as the damaged component: the sample is destroyed and every creature within Very Close range makes a Strength Reaction Roll, DC 15; on failure become Poisoned, on success no Condition.

name: Field Printer Micro-Rig
effect: Fabricates one small simple part during downtime. Requires feedstock.

name: Med Evac Harness
effect: Drag or carry an unconscious ally slowly. Obvious target if attacked.

name: Surgical Assist Suite
effect: Advantage to Medic for remote stabilization or emergency surgery. Never replaces Medic.

name: Reinforced Plating
effect: +2 Major / +2 Severe thresholds; -1 Evasion. Cannot stack with Low-Profile Frame unless Experimental.

name: Redundant Core
effect: First time destroyed in a scene, drops to Dead Weight instead and can be recovered.

name: Emergency Return Logic
effect: When reduced to 1 HP or signal becomes Lost, attempts Return automatically unless commanded otherwise.

name: Armor Booster
effect: +1 Armor Slot. Military or Experimental only.

name: EMP Hardening
effect: EMP does not automatically disable the drone; roll normally or treat result as one severity lower.

name: Thermal Sink
effect: Thermal detection against the drone has Disadvantage. After the drone takes a second Action in one round, its signal becomes Unstable until the end of the next round.

name: Self-Sealing Casing
effect: Once per Short Rest, Long Rest, or Downtime, restore 1 lost drone HP without a Roll. It cannot revive a destroyed drone or repair an offline module.

name: Disposable Shell
effect: One-use casing. When destroyed, internal data core survives unless hit by EMP, fire, acid, or similar damage.

name: Predictive Motion Suite
effect: Military/Experimental only. Once per scene, gain +2 Evasion against one attack the drone can perceive. If the next drone Roll is Fear-dominant and noncritical, its signal worsens one step until the end of the operator's next Spotlight.

name: Chameleon Profile
effect: +1 Evasion against Far or longer ranged attacks while moving slowly or near cover. Attacking, cutting, boosting, or transmitting strongly cancels until reposition.

name: Reflex Kernel
effect: Experimental. Gain +1 Evasion, including while signal is Unstable. After a Fear-dominant noncritical drone Roll, lose this bonus until the start of the drone's next Spotlight.

name: Threat-Prediction Ghostware
effect: Experimental/illegal. Once per scene, after an attacker resolves a hit or miss, impose Disadvantage on its next attack. After a Fear-dominant noncritical drone Roll, this module goes offline until an Action and Knowledge (Tech) Roll, DC 10, restores it; it never retargets a player Action.

name: Vector Bleed Jets
effect: Experimental. +2 Evasion in zero-g/EVA; -1 Evasion in cramped interiors or gravity-heavy spaces.

name: Decentralized Motion Nodes
effect: Ignore the first Evasion penalty from damaged mobility. Does not prevent Lost-signal penalty.

name: Suppressive Emitter
effect: Operator Action. Enemies in small area choose: move safely, attack with Disadvantage, or expose themselves.

name: Point-Defense Spark
effect: Reaction. Once per scene, attempt to intercept grenade, micromissile, or hostile drone.

name: EMP Pulse Pod
effect: One use. Worsens nearby drone/electronic signal by one state or disables Cheap drones. Friendly drones included.

name: Net Launcher
effect: Attack. On hit, pin small drone or slow humanoid until Action clears it.

name: Hardpoint Mount
effect: Allows real light weapon. Uses operator Action. No Proficiency scaling unless explicitly permitted.

name: Shock Halo
effect: First creature that grabs or physically attacks drone marks 1 Stress or lets go.

name: Breach Charge Mount
effect: One shaped charge. Opens doors/hulls or destroys drone as part of detonation. Illegal.

name: Overclock Core
effect: Once per scene, the drone takes one Action without spending the operator's Action. The operator then chooses exactly one: drone loses 1 direct HP; one operator-chosen module goes offline until an Action and Knowledge (Tech), DC 10, restores it; or signal worsens one state. If the drone's Action resolves Failure with Fear, also roll once on the Core Drone Complication table.

name: Field Reconfiguration
effect: Once per session, swap one installed module with reserve during downtime. Requires tools and a safe scene.

name: Ghost-Signal Lattice
effect: In Unstable signal, perform complex tasks normally. With Lost signal, send one final simple command. If that command resolves Failure with Fear, one established hostile receiver in the scene detects the operator's zone; if none exists, no receiver appears retroactively.

name: Prototype Autonomy Core
effect: Load one routine of up to three named simple commands during a Long Rest. With Lost signal, execute them in order without improvisation. On a Fear-dominant noncritical Roll, the routine stops after that command and cannot resume until signal is restored.

name: Veil-Hardened Casing
effect: Treat Veil interference as one signal state less severe. Also makes drone visible to things that notice Veil disturbance.

name: Probability Stabilizer
effect: Once per scene after a nonmatching drone movement or signal Roll, reroll the Hope die and use the new face. It may create a Critical Success. If the new result is Failure with Fear, the drone loses Hidden and its signal worsens one state.

name: Memory Imprint Slot
effect: Once per session, gain Advantage on one Roll directly tied to the stored echo. Afterward mark 1 Stress; the echo is a narrative prompt and never controls an Action or adds another consequence.

name: Black-Site Kill Switch
effect: If captured/hijacked, drone can self-delete or self-destruct. Someone else may know trigger.

name: Phase Blink Array
effect: Once per scene, the drone may phase-jump up to Close range. It can pass through ordinary solid matter, but not through active energy protection, phase locks, military shields, Veil wards, or similar countermeasures. After use, it needs several uninterrupted minutes to recharge. Blind phase-jumps are possible but dangerous.

name: Phase Capacitor
effect: Requires Phase Blink Array. Stores one additional phase-jump charge per scene. Each installed Phase Capacitor adds +1 phase jump per scene. All spent charges require several uninterrupted minutes to recharge. Repeated jumps make heat, signal instability, and phase residue increasingly obvious.
